Create an app for our idea: • Lumena — An Adaptive AI Companion for Holistic Dyslexia Support
"While typical readers may tend to miss the forest because its view is blocked by all the
trees, people with dyslexia may...miss the trees, but see the forest."
 — Matthew H. Schneps
Learning should be an accessible and engaging experience for everyone.
However, for the estimated 1 in 10 students with dyslexia, everyday
academic tasks like reading, writing, focusing, and managing time become
constant and exhausting challenges. Dyslexia is a learning difference that
affects how the brain processes written and spoken language. Students
with dyslexia may struggle with decoding words, letter recognition,
spelling, and short-term memory—making traditional study methods
overwhelming and frustrating.
Existing support systems such as tutoring or assistive software often take a
one-size-fits-all approach, failing to recognize that every dyslexic learner’s
difficulty and progress patterns are unique. This is where Artificial
Intelligence becomes extremely helpful. AI can observe how each
student learns, identify patterns in their reading and comprehension, and
adapt instantly to their needs. By providing real-time, personalized
support, AI helps transform learning from a struggle into a more intuitive
and empowering experience.
2. Objectives / Purpose:
The main goal of Lumena is to bridge the gap between traditional learning
support and the real, everyday struggles faced by students with dyslexia.
Most existing systems depend heavily on therapy sessions, classroom
accommodations, or generic learning apps that often fail to adapt to
individual needs or provide emotional support. As a result, many
dyslexic students continue to struggle with reading difficulties,
concentration issues, low confidence, and social anxiety.
Lumena aims to change this by creating an adaptive AI-powered support
system that offers personalized learning assistance, focus management,
and emotional encouragement—all in one platform. Its purpose is not only
to simplify learning through audio conversion, motion-based focus
detection, and customizable visuals, but also to promote self-confidence
and independence in dyslexic learners.
3. Methodology / Approach:
Lumena AI was developed using a combination of Artificial Intelligence
(AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Computer Vision technologies to
support the unique learning needs of students with dyslexia. The system
integrates multiple models to analyse text patterns, recognize visual cues,
and track user interaction for adaptive learning.
The Natural Language Processing (NLP) algorithm enables Lumena AI to
simplify and rephrase complex text, making reading more accessible for
dyslexic learners. The system also employs Optical Character
Recognition (OCR) to detect and convert printed or on-screen text into
readable audio, assisting students who struggle with reading fluency.
Computer Vision models are used to track user motion and gestures,
helping the AI evaluate engagement and adjust interactions accordingly.
Machine Learning algorithms analyse user behaviour over time to
personalize the learning experience and recommend suitable focus or
comprehension exercises.
Development tools such as Python, C++, and TypeScript were utilized to
design, train, and implement the models, supported by datasets
containing reading patterns, motion data, and user feedback to enhance
system accuracy and adaptability.
4. Key features:
1. Study Timer with Exercise Integration – The system includes an
interactive study timer that encourages focus through timed study
sessions followed by short physical exercises. Using motion
detection, it tracks user movement and awards points, promoting
both productivity and motivation.
2. Task Roadmap with Audio Guidance – Lumena AI generates a
personalized roadmap where tasks are clearly organized and read
aloud through AI-generated audio. This assists learners who face
reading difficulties, allowing them to receive instructions auditorily.
3. Motion Sensor for Focus Tracking – The built-in motion sensor
tracks movement and engagement levels during study sessions,
helping students maintain concentration and reducing distractions.
4. Dyslexia-Friendly Interface – The interface adapts automatically
adjusting background colour, font size, and letter spacing to
minimize visual stress and make text clearer for dyslexic reader.
5. Emotional Support System – The AI monitors user activity and
provides gentle verbal affirmations, motivational prompts, and
positive reinforcement. It celebrates achievements, awards virtual
points, and acknowledges milestones, fostering self-esteem and
emotional balance.
6. Focus Enhancement with Background Audio – The app features
calming background music and white noise options to create an
ideal focus environment, minimizing distraction and improving
sustained attention.
7. Verbal Reminders and Thinking Time – Lumena AI provides verbal
prompts while allowing additional “thinking time,” helping students
with language retrieval difficulties to express themselves
comfortably.
8. Audio Reminders and Scheduling – Lumena AI sets customized
audio-based reminders for study sessions, alarms, and daily
activities (e.g., morning and night), helping students with time
management and preventing confusion with a.m./p.m. distinctions.
• Expected Outcome / Result:
Many dyslexic students face more than academic challenges — including
anxiety, low confidence, and even bullying, which can make school feel
overwhelming. Lumena aims to change that by offering a supportive, AIdriven space that empowers students to learn at their own pace.
With personalized tools like text-to-speech, focus tracking, and a calming
interface, Lumena helps students overcome reading barriers, reduce
stress, and regain confidence in their studies. It not only improves
academic performance but also supports emotional well-being and selfesteem, encouraging consistent learning and independence.
5. Conclusion / Significance:
Its potential applications extend to personal use by students. Schools
could use it as part of inclusive learning programs, parents could rely on it
at home to assist their children, and special education centres could
integrate it into therapy sessions. It can even act as an awareness tool,
helping teachers and peers understand dyslexia better and reduce the
stigma around it. With time, Lumena has the potential to inspire a global
movement—one where technology uplifts every learner and turns
challenges into confidence.

• Dyslexia Support

• Inclusive Learning
• Emotional Support
